## Operating note: concurrent writes in the shared tree

This session ran in the shared working tree alongside other builders (S1/S3/S4
sweeps were live). Several times during this run, edits I had just made to
`locales/ar.json`, `locales/en.json`, `locales/partials/b5.ar.json`,
`locales/partials/b5.en.json`, `app/content/about.ts`, `app/components/pages/AboutPage.tsx`
and `app/routes/account.notifications.tsx` were reverted on disk by a
concurrent sync/merge I do not control, then later converged back to include
my changes once the concurrent batch's own edits landed. I re-applied every
reverted edit each time it happened and, before finishing, re-verified every
file this batch touched by grep and re-ran the full test suite, typecheck and
lint gates as the final step, all green. Flagging this so the conductor
double-checks the merged result before shipping rather than trusting a single
clean run mid-session.

`ServicePdp.tsx` (56 → ~100 lines) now renders, in addition to the existing

- the consultation credit line (unchanged, gated on the setting);

  `prayer_note`/`friday_note` scheduling notes and the change/cancel rule

New test file `tests/product/ServicePdp.test.tsx` (6 tests): service vs.
booking paths, the full next-steps sequence for booking, no slot-picker
strings ever render, the video/visit change rule by SKU, no change rule for

including the existing C14 service/booking slot-line test), which I did not

**Findings filed (not fixed — outside this batch's files, or the same known
class of issue already named in the brief):**

1. **`/cart`, `/testimonials`, `/search` (with a query) carry zero `<h1>` in
   the raw SSR HTML.** Both `CartHeader` (`headingLevel` unconditional `h1`)
   and `CartEmpty`/`Testimonials.Component` are designed to carry exactly
   one h1, but their real content depends on a client-side data fetch
   (`useCartData`, the engine's own comments API) that has not resolved at
   SSR time; the skeleton renders instead and carries no heading. All three
   routes are `noindex`. Not a markup defect in the owning files (I checked
   `CartHeader.tsx`, `CartEmpty.tsx`, `testimonials.tsx`: all correctly pass
   `headingLevel="h1"` / rely on the engine's `page.title`), and none are
   S6-owned. Filing for the conductor rather than editing client-data-fetch
   timing.

2. **A second, engine-native `<h1>` is visible in the raw SSR HTML on every
   native account page and on `/brands`, before hydration, and on some
   routes its text is a raw platform-bundle key** (`common.titles.notifications`,
   `common.titles.brands`, etc.). Root cause, confirmed by inspection:
   `AccountShell`'s own docstring documents the intended fix — the engine
   prints its own centred h1 from `page.title` inside `.main-content`, and
   `_b6-commerce.scss:1090` (`body.ox-account .main-content > h1 { display:
   none; }`) is supposed to hide it. In the SSR response, `<body>` carries no
   class at all (`useDocumentClass`'s server-mirroring did not apply in this
   preview), so the hiding rule never matches before hydration, and a
   crawler or JS-off client would see two h1s. Separately, the TEXT some of
   these carry (`common.titles.*`) is the engine's own translator resolving
   against the Salla platform CDN string bundle, which this offline preview
   cannot reach (`common.titles.home`, `.categories`, `.account` do exist in
   our own `locales/ar.json`, but `.brands`, `.wishlist`, `.orders`,
   `.notifications`, `.cart` do not — they were never ours to define; they
   are engine-only strings). This is the same class of issue the brief
   already names for the header search placeholder ("the raw key ... from
   the engine translator"), just on a different surface family, and
   `_b6-commerce.scss`/`AccountShell.tsx` already contain the correct fix
   for a hydrated client; only the pre-hydration SSR snapshot is affected.
   `_b6-commerce.scss` is in my Files list, but the root cause (SSR class
   mirroring) is `useDocumentClass`/`DocumentClassProvider` engine behaviour,
   not a CSS selector bug, so I filed this rather than attempting a deeper
   fix under time pressure. `/brands` composition is explicitly S1's
   (`BrandsGrid`/`BrandHeader`) per the plan's shared-file table; filed
   there too.

3. **`/loyalty`, `/account/wallet`, `/account/settings` return HTTP 500 in
   both locales**, body "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'name')".
   All three call an engine loader (`Loyalty.loader`, `Wallet.loader`,
   `Settings.loader`) I did not write and have not edited; `orders`,
   `wishlist`, `notifications` and `profile` call sibling engine loaders and
   render fine, so the crash is specific to whatever those three additionally
   fetch. Not reproducible from anything in this batch's diff (git blame
   shows none of the three route files touched this session). Filing as a
   blocking finding: I could not verify the wallet or loyalty empty states
   from this preview session because of it (`account.wallet.tsx` and
   `loyalty.tsx` render `AccountEmpty`/a dedicated panel correctly by code
   inspection — the copy and route-out are present in source — but the
   crash happens before either component mounts).
